summary: Implementation plan for removing automatic @Hikaru archive/match fetching on initial load in favor of an instant Showcase Demo profile, unifying single-source Chess.com account synchronization across HeroSection, PerformanceDashboard, MoveByMoveAnalyzer, and PersonalPuzzlesPage, and adding a dedicated Flip Board control that rotates board squares, coordinates, and evaluation bar while keeping move-evaluation badges anchored at the top-right of the moved piece.
